- Calculates days to high elevation: 15 + (15-1) = 29 days. (Implies he needs to reach 15 wall, then add 15 more days to reach 15 high? The logic is flawed. To reach 15 high, he needs 15 wall + 15 high = 30 days total? Or does he need to reach 15 reps on high elevation? The problem says "once he gets to 15 reps he will start training high elevation". This implies the threshold is 15 reps. So to reach 15 wall, it takes 15 days. To reach 15 high, he needs to do 15 reps on high elevation. Since he adds 1 rep a day, that takes another 15 days. Total days = 15 + 15 = 30 days. The student calculates 29 days).

- Calculates days to floor: 43 + (15-1) = 57 days.
